title: Constraint-Driven Hybrid Dynamical System Formalization
purpose: Guide an agent to formalize SPM using continuous dynamics, discrete updates, and topological admissibility constraints

core_claim.statement: SPM should be modeled as a constraint-driven hybrid dynamical system.

interpretation.⇔: analog closure between persistence and change

continuous_layer.name: Dynamical Systems
continuous_layer.role: models smooth continuation between threshold events

discrete_layer.name: Discrete Operator Theory
discrete_layer.role: models δ events, recoupling, phase flips, and regime transitions

constraint_layer.name: Set Theory and Topology
constraint_layer.role: defines what states and transitions are allowed

preferred_formalism.name: Constraint-Driven Hybrid Dynamical System
preferred_formalism.definition: A hybrid system where admissibility constraints define and regulate both continuous flow and discrete transition events.
preferred_formalism.important_note: Do not treat continuous and discrete models as rivals. Treat them as two expressions of one process under constraint.

core_equations.event_trigger: δ(ℰ>0) occurs when admissibility threshold is crossed

engine_logic.step_1: Initialize nonzero admissible state x with ε(x) ≠ 0.
engine_logic.step_3: Monitor admissibility boundaries and phase mismatch thresholds.
engine_logic.step_4: When threshold condition is met, apply δ event update.
engine_logic.step_5: Update residue R after realized transition.
engine_logic.step_6: Recompute admissible set A and forbidden set F.

validation_tests.requirement: No admissible trajectory may cross into ε = 0.
Threshold crossings must generate δ updates rather than undefined behavior.
Changing R must alter future admissibility or evolution.
Every exclusion-side law must have an addition-side counterpart.
Continuous flow and discrete updates must not contradict the master constraint.

agent_tasks: Formalize CDHDS as the preferred mathematical class.
Do not choose only PDEs or only discrete operators.
Use topology/set theory as the admissibility layer.
Represent δ as event update, not ordinary derivative.
Represent ℰ≠0 as admissibility condition, not scalar magnitude only.
Derive equivalent law families from both sides of the master statement.
Identify where continuous evolution hands off to discrete update.
Flag any place where ε = 0 becomes admissible as a violation.

avoid: treating this as pure PDE only
treating this as pure cellular automata only
collapsing δ into a normal derivative
claiming physical proof without simulation or prediction

compressed_summary: Model SPM as a constraint-driven hybrid dynamical system: topology defines admissibility, continuous dynamics expresses ongoing continuation, and discrete δ events express positive recoupling under the master constraint (ℰ≠0) ⇔ δ(ℰ>0).
